name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const ()) -> Thread
rule: The pointer passed to Thread::from_raw must have been previously returned by Thread::into_raw; passing any other pointer is undefined behavior, even if the returned Thread is never accessed.
api: impl  std::thread::Thread { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const ()) -> std::thread::Thread }
expression: No valid DSL expression can represent this requirement: the grammar provides no observation of whether $1 was previously returned by Thread::into_raw.
